summary: Server-side state of ls::anubis::System while it restores Anubis (behaviour script) trees from a savegame: the SavegameVisitor taken from ls::anubis::LoadRequestOneFrameComponent, an ls::anubis::savegame::Reader over the saved data, a set of entities and two flags. Seen in the same step as LoadRequestOneFrameComponent (level change through S_CTY_LevelSwapTeleporter_WYR).
